fields.Name: IT164 - Graph Runtime Permissions
fields.Description: Exercises the semantic graph runtime against the live database without saving anything. GR1: the seeded "MJ Canon" graph is Preload, runs its three metadata edge providers, and traverses entity References edges. GR2: a user who cannot run a query never sees its node, whether filtered, used as a seed, or present as an audience reader of a user who can. GR3: an edge cannot be created pre-approved without Graph: Approve Edges (checked through ValidateAsync on an unsaved edge). GR4: Get Graph Context resolves to GetGraphContextAction, has its metadata row, fails with GRAPH_NOT_FOUND for an unknown graph and expands a real seed.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: The canon graph traverses metadata edges; query nodes are invisible to users who cannot run the query, including through an audience; approval needs Graph: Approve Edges; Get Graph Context is registered and runs.
